metadata.description: AWOS plugins for AI-native development workflows

plugins.name: awos
plugins.description: Extends AWOS core with AI-readiness auditing: /awos:ai-readiness-audit scores a repository — or a whole org — across quality dimensions with a deterministic measurement engine and renders evidence-backed reports; also ships the directly-invocable configure-external-sources skill.

plugins.name: better
plugins.description: Experimental research-backed functional specs: /better:spec forks the core spec flow, fans out codebase, web, and internal-KB research agents before drafting, and blind-verifies the written spec with a context-free reader.
